glossary.definition: (1) "Cost of relocation" includes the actual cost paid by a utility directly attributable to relocation after deducting any increase in the value of the new facility and any salvage value derived from the old facility.
glossary.source_title: Section 5501.51 - Reimbursing utility for facilities relocated by highway project.
